narration: The Guttered Lantern. Low beams, sticky tables, a fire that argues with the damp. The barkeep polishes the same mug. Door to the road. Stairs up to rooms. Smell of broth, wet wool, old stories. A stranger maps wet rings on the table and will not look up. first drink free if you promise to come back breathing. Calcifer is here, and wants something. keep chimney smokes black — wrong for weather. Ways out: out toward Dusty Road to the Keep; north toward Dusty Road to the Keep; up toward Lantern Loft.
